intro: Starberry uses a simple player-driven economy built around trading, player shops, and a dependable way to turn useful resources into money.
currency_description: Your balance is used for player shops, trading, PlayerWarps, and other server features. Most of the economy is meant to come from players buying and selling with each other.
currency_goal: The goal is to keep money useful and community-driven without turning normal Minecraft progression into a grind for cash.

player_shops.description: Players can create their own shops using QuickShop chests, setting items for sale or purchase directly from a chest.
player_shops.warps_description: PlayerWarps make it easier to create destinations for towns, markets, shops, attractions, and other player-made locations.

bank.name: The Bank
bank.name_note: This feature may receive a more Starberry-themed name before launch.
bank.description: The Bank provides a simple way to sell selected resources directly to the server. Diamonds are the starting baseline, and additional items such as custom crops may also be sellable here.
bank.additional_selling: Custom crops and other selected resources may be added as additional ways to earn money through the Bank.
bank.reason: Diamonds give the economy a familiar Minecraft resource as its baseline while player shops remain the heart of trading. Allowing selected crops and resources to be sold provides a steady money source without replacing the player economy.
